unsupported: TSMC, founded in 1987, pioneered the dedicated foundry model; the Washington site was established as one of six global manufacturing locations to extend that model into the United States.
Customers span the computer, communications, and consumer electronics sectors, relying on TSMC Washington for volume production and quick-turn prototyping.
The site serves TSMC's global customer base directly, offering a full array of manufacturing services from design enablement through final test.
